protocol.ordering: Point-major locked grid, then original 12-source manifest order.
protocol.lifecycle: Per-stream create / explicit DEFAULT or SET / all 63 zero-prime returns / complete PCM / final-only partial512 padding / destroy.
protocol.event_policy: All raw positive events; preserve 0 and -1 counts separately. No custom smoothing/refractory/rearm.
protocol.waveform_policy: Copy original 12 WAV files verbatim; no new synthesis, resampling, gain, trim or selection.
protocol.decision_policy: Authenticate runtime/getters/all events and retain every point. No operating-point choice or recognition pass/fail; preserve failures without retry/extension.
protocol.scope: Consumed synthetic same-PCM reference-runtime witnesses. No background exposure, FAR, phonetic/real wake latency, parity or independent acceptance.
